decisions.reason: It is closely aligned with the firm's established airport and border-security know-how and already shows strong validated use, so an expanding firm with product-development capability is very likely to keep improving it rather than withdraw it.

Because it builds on the firm's existing travel compliance and passenger-processing expertise and remained marketed through 2024, management would likely keep it, though with some risk if demand proves less durable than for core security products.

This web platform sits close to the firm's core document, verification, and operational security capabilities, and its continued presence on the website suggests enough fit and learning potential for management to keep it on the market.
